title: One Year Into Gaza Ceasefire: 1,493 Killed Since Truce, Israel Controls Nearly Two-Thirds of Strip
detail: Gaza's Health Ministry reported 1,493 killed and 5,299 wounded since the October 2025 ceasefire as of Oct 12, with a cumulative toll of 74,382 since Oct 2023. Al Jazeera reports Israel controls nearly two-thirds of the Strip (versus roughly 50% intended), aid trucks are entering at about a third of the agreed rate, and more than 18,500 patients need medical evacuation.

media.caption: Gaza marks one year of 'ceasefire' with more Israeli killing
